name: Ashvane
subtitle: Your clip desk and a private AI, in your pocket.

apps.name: Ashvane
apps.subtitle: Your clip desk and a private AI, in your pocket.
apps.localizedDescription:
Ashvane watches the biggest Twitch and Kick streams on your PC, catches the moments chat loses it over, and turns them into vertical clips ready to post. This app puts the whole desk in your pocket, next to a private AI that lives on the phone.

CONTENT DESK
- See today's cuts, production queue, publishing connections and post results
- Research original ideas with linked sources, scripts and separate platform copy
- Read clip judgments, timed evidence and finished-video checks before publishing

REMOTE
- See every stream it is watching, with viewers and how hot chat is running
- Look through the clips it made and post the good ones straight away
- Change the look of your clips in Studio, and every setting, from the couch
- Pause and resume capture, and read what it is doing and why

ASSISTANT
- Runs on the phone itself: it checks your phone and downloads the largest model that will run well on it, then works with no PC and no internet
- Attach photos, videos and files; send a video link and it watches it with your PC's help
- Skills you call with /name - research, learn, grill-me, watch-this, plan and more - plus your own, and rules that apply to every chat
- A Code mode for writing and explaining code

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Locked with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode. No account and no cloud: the app talks only to your own PC, on your Wi-Fi or over Tailscale, and asks for your Ashvane password.

privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock with Face ID so nobody else can open your desk or your chats.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Ashvane talks to the Ashvane app running on your PC over your local network.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach photos and videos to a message for the assistant.
